scope: Overview acceptance returns next to acceptance passes; both counters deduplicate TIDs across the selected date range.

behavior.returnEvents: acceptance_fail excluding isAcceptanceReject; includes inspected failures and follow-batch returns.
behavior.dates: Beijing event dates, then Set<TID> over selected interval. A day counts that day; the multi-day union is not the sum of daily rows.
behavior.passCorrection: Previous overview summed daily completedTIDs; now uses range-wide TID union, matching the group table.
behavior.independentMetrics: A TID returned then passed may contribute once to each counter. These are flow activity counts, not disjoint current statuses.
behavior.boundaries: Scope by mode, group and role; deleted tasks and pre-release events excluded; current projected TID handles corrections.
behavior.unchanged: Accuracy, QC metrics, daily report rows/exports, workflow, API and task data unchanged.
behavior.cache: Adds acceptance dates to existing bounded snapshot/identity/mode/group review-facts cache. Date changes reuse facts.

deployment.rollback: Restore saved index with candidate SHA guard. Preserve all immutable assets and API.
